summary.text: Scott Allen Fuller is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 5, listed with Wayne County; the district covers parts of Cabell and Wayne counties. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Enrolled Bills, Military, and Select Substance Use Disorder and Mental Health committees.

paragraphs.text: Fuller's page lists his occupation as retired law enforcement and military, and gives his birthplace as Huntington, West Virginia.
It names his spouse as Kelly Fuller and lists five children.

Fuller also serves on the Senate's Banking and Insurance, Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, Health and Human Resources, Judiciary and Workforce committees, and between sessions he chairs the interim Volunteer Fire Departments and Emergency Medical Services committee.
